note: 12 claims: 4 confirmed, 7 corrected, 1 unverified. Headline: Go-Live needs a paid production account, manual review typically takes 24-48 hours, and secrets and redirect URIs are not copied to production, so they must be re-added there.

rows.composio: Admin > Integrations > Apps and Keys > Add App and Integration Key.
rows.ours: Developer account, Settings > Apps and Keys > Add App and Integration Key.
rows.provider: Apps and Keys still works; the Developer Console (open beta) is now 'the single location where you can manage (IKs) across both the demo and production environments.'

rows.composio: Add URI under Additional Settings; must match character-for-character.
rows.ours: Exact match normally required; count, localhost and HTTPS limits unknown.
rows.provider: 'You must define at least one redirect URI... You may set more than one redirect URI per app'; redirect URIs cannot contain fragments. Exact-match wording not found.

rows.composio: Optional 'Require PKCE' setting on a confidential app; can be left off.
rows.ours: Public ACG uses PKCE (inferred from a blog title).
rows.provider: Public ACG 'uses Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) to authenticate securely without requiring a client secret'; confidential ACG may add PKCE; method s256.

rows.claim: Refresh tokens and the extended scope
rows.ours: extended is commonly paired with signature for refresh tokens; unconfirmed.
rows.provider: Refresh tokens last 'typically around 30 days'; with extended each refresh issues a full-lifetime token, without it the original expiry stays.
Token responses show expires_in 28800 (8 hours); Docusign recommends refreshing when close to expiry, e.g. within 30 minutes.
'The authorization code is only viable for two minutes.'

rows.composio: Developer uses account-d.docusign.com; production uses account.docusign.com.
rows.provider: Developer base URI https://account-d.docusign.com/oauth/auth; production https://account.docusign.com/oauth/auth; token at /oauth/token on each.

rows.ours: May need a paid or production account; unknown.
rows.provider: 'You have a paid production account to manage the integration in production'; ISV partners may qualify for a free management account; admin access required.

rows.ours: Review wait is not published; unknown.
rows.provider: 'Manual reviews are typically completed within 24–48 hours'; some apps get automatic promotion after one-time identity verification.

rows.ours: Dropped in 2025 per a third-party blog; unconfirmed.
rows.provider: Current Go-Live page lists account and integration requirements and 'take integrations live with a single click'; it does not mention an API-call count either way.

rows.claim: What carries over to production after Go-Live
rows.composio: Create a separate config pointing to account.docusign.com with the production key.
rows.ours: Promote the key, then switch to account.docusign.com and per-user base URIs.
rows.provider: Key is copied with the same value, but 'secrets and redirect URIs are not copied automatically'; configure them separately in production.

rows.claim: Userinfo call returns the base URI
rows.ours: GET /oauth/userinfo with Bearer token returns accounts with base_uri (assumed).
rows.provider: GET https://account-d.docusign.com/oauth/userinfo (account.docusign.com in production) returns account_id and base_uri; hourly rate limits apply.
